The '''Daupherm Systems Fleet''' was a fleet that served the [[Daupherm Planet States]]. It used [[Discril-class attack cruiser|''Discril''-class attack cruisers]]. One cruiser was stolen by its former [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Gorvan Shrulldike]]. Renamed [[Retribution (Discril-class)|''Retribution'']], it operated as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] ship.
